scope: Reviewed unlanded vocabulary proposal only; not_landed / owner_review_later. No application, board, target, partition, pairing, recipe, route, difficulty or runtime approval.
rubric_sections: CRITIQUE_RUBRIC A1-A4 and A7 contextual predicate honesty
CRITIQUE_RUBRIC F recognition/relevance checks; board-specific B-E rules reserved until a complete board/target/recipe exists

method.independence: Quality review did not read the factual verdict and authored no candidate, alias or new edge endpoint. Every selected item and every unique proposed edge was inspected.
method.sources: Live Romanian Wiktionary/Wikipedia and current operators, manufacturers, municipality, museum and school-road-safety sources; author raw DEX/DOOM entries inspected locally for all selected items. Thirteen ambiguity/paradigm/failed-Wiki items additionally re-fetched directly from DEX JSON after the factual reviewer released the dictionary slot.
method.dictionary_pacing: Waited 2.1 seconds after slot release; one serial helper kept every request start at least 2.1 seconds apart; no parallel DEX requests.
method.access_limits: Some direct web-tool pages returned cache errors or navigation-only extracts; targeted indexed primary-source text and direct paced dictionary checks supplied the stated evidence. Failed-Wiki sources are not listed as successfully checked for Hangar, Pasarelă, Spiță or Microbuz.
method.inference: Common physical function/material associations are judged as explicitly scoped possibilities; museum object/class examples do not become universal claims. Frequency supports recognition only and never rejects an everyday/school/culture noun.

items.rationale: Familiar contemporary feminine driver noun, matching the existing person/driver role. Preserve it as a feminine person input, not an unrestricted gender-neutral lexical synonym; all five normalized forms remain ordinary.
Familiar pedestrian street margin. The missing plural genitive trotuarelor completes the existing same-sense paradigm without relabeling or adding a competing concept.
Universally recognizable urban-road noun. Străzii/străzilor are ordinary genitive/dative completions for the existing physical-street sense, not the collective inhabitants sense.
Familiar rail convoy. Trenului/trenurilor complete the existing railway sense; no gear-train, aircraft landing gear or other technical meaning is introduced.
Familiar urban rail transport. Tramvaiului/tramvaielor complete the ordinary tramvaie paradigm without regional variants or any change to existing puzzle content.
Familiar railway station. Gării/gărilor are ordinary missing inflections within the existing station scope; a maritime-terminal meaning is not introduced.
Familiar transport stopping point. Stației/stațiilor complete that exact sense; scientific stations, resorts, bodily posture and funeral stops remain excluded.
Familiar school and travel place. Aeroportului/aeroporturilor complete the same airport sense and do not introduce a new aerodrom synonym or change the existing definition.
Familiar motorized goods vehicle. Camionului/camioanelor complete the existing modern truck sense; the separate animal-drawn vehicle meaning is excluded.
Familiar small passenger bus. Live DEX/DOOM3 corroborates microbuze and the existing small-bus sense; only missing microbuzului/microbuzelor are proposed.
Familiar school and household vehicle. Bicicletei/bicicletelor are ordinary missing genitive/dative forms for the unchanged existing pedal-driven vehicle sense.
